parameter.name: home_prefix
parameter.description: The prefix to use for user home directories. On SELinux systems, a custom prefix must have a persistent file-context equivalence to /home before users' homes are created. This labels the prefix home_root_t and applies the normal home/content contexts to its whole subtree. For example: .nf sudo mkdir -p /home/entra sudo semanage fcontext -a -e /home "$(readlink -f /home/entra)" sudo restorecon -R "$(readlink -f /home/entra)" .fi Resolve the destination when /home is a symlink, such as on Aurora; retain /home as the equivalence source. Use the same setup for prefixes outside /home. Relabel only the configured prefix. Changing just its directory label with chcon does not provide the descendant file-context rules.
parameter.conf_description: Prefix used when creating user home directories.
